description:
Job Title: Data Engineer, EDM III BRL- 10 Years

Location : Brazil remote

Project Duration: 6 months



Job description:

Primary Skills

SQL, Python, Pyspark, Airflow, AWS, MLOPs

Secondary Skills

Communication, leadership, project management

Position Overview

The BMP (Business Model and Pricing) Analytics team is seeking an experienced Data Engineer to support business performance management and strategic decision-making through scalable data infrastructure and engineering solutions. The team partners closely with leadership, finance, operations, and business stakeholders to enable reliable, high-quality data access, support advanced analytics, and drive data-informed actions across the organization.

The Data Engineer will play a critical role in designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines, data models, and foundational data assets that power analytics, reporting, and emerging AI/ML capabilities. This role requires strong engineering rigor, a deep understanding of data systems, and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of building scalable data solutions in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and is comfortable balancing foundational data platform work with evolving analytics and AI-driven initiatives.


What you will do

You have a strong engineering and problem-solving mindset. You translate business and analytical needs into scalable, reliable data solutions and architectures.

You design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data models that support business performance monitoring, analytics, and reporting, while contributing to the development of the BMP Data Foundation across Hive, Snowflake and data lake environments.


You support the buildout of data products and applications, including contributing to Streamlit-based pipelines and the development of chatbot capabilities to enhance data access and user interaction.

You collaborate closely with analytics, data science, and business teams to ensure data availability, quality, and usability for dashboards, reporting, and advanced analyses.

You enable and support the buildout of advanced analytics, machine learning and AI capabilities, ensuring the necessary data infrastructure, pipelines, and environments are in place to support model development and deployment.

You contribute to the design and evolution of the data and ML ecosystem, helping establish the infrastructure, processes, and foundations required to scale AI/ML initiatives across the organization.


Minimum Qualifications

• Master’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform development, or related roles.

• Strong experience with SQL and at least one programming language (Python or equivalent).

• Familiarity with big data and distributed processing frameworks (e.g., Spark / PySpark).

• Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and working with modern data architectures.

• Experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow) and pipeline automation.

• Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS) and data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake).

• Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, and data governance principles.

• Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work with ambiguous requirements.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Fluent in English.



Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with data lake architectures and hybrid data environments.

• Experience supporting machine learning pipelines and infrastructure.

• Exposure to data applications (e.g., Streamlit) and conversational interfaces (chatbots).

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools and practices.

• Experience contributing to documentation and knowledge-sharing platforms (e.g., Confluence).

• Experience working in a matrixed, global organization.

title: Chief Technology Officer - CTO
description:
Purpose of the Position

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.


More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.
  • Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.
  • Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.
  • Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.
  • Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.
  • Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.
  • Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.
  • Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.
  • Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.
  • Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.g., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).
  • Systems architecture expertise : Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).
  • Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.g., telecom, data centers, financial systems).
  • Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.
  • Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.
  • Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.
  • Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.
  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA or executive education is a plus.


Behavioral Skills

  • Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results; drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.
  • Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively; brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.
  • Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others; adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.
  • Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.
  • Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility; leads by example.

Identificar oportunidades comerciais que contribuam para a diversificação de mercados e fortalecimento da presença da companhia no mercado;

  • Desejável experiência com clientes internacionais e entendimento de práticas de exportação.


Formação

title: Desenvolvedor BackEnd Sênior - JavaScript/Node + AWS
description:
Sobre a InBot

Somos uma empresa especializada em Inteligência Artificial Conversacional. Desenvolvemos assistentes virtuais inteligentes que integram PLN (Processamento de Linguagem Natural), busca semântica e IA generativa, oferecendo experiências únicas para usuários e resultados práticos para nossos clientes.


Na InBot, você vai trabalhar com projetos que envolvem desde personagens digitais (como Mia, Ricardo, Fernando) até soluções robustas para grandes empresas e governos, usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar a comunicação entre pessoas e organizações.

Mais sobre nós:


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Arquitetura e Refinamento Técnico (Discovery → Delivery): Atuar junto às áreas de negócio e ao time técnico no levantamento, análise e refinamento de requisitos, traduzindo necessidades em especificações técnicas claras (user stories, critérios de aceite, regras de negócio, fluxos e integrações) e apoiando a definição da melhor arquitetura para entrega.
  • Gestão Técnica do Backlog: Apoiar a organização e priorização técnica das demandas, garantindo que as atividades estejam bem detalhadas, quebradas em entregas incrementais e com dependências mapeadas, reduzindo retrabalho e aumentando previsibilidade.
  • Definição de Solução e Padrões: Propor e documentar padrões técnicos, decisões de arquitetura (ADRs), contratos de API e boas práticas (observabilidade, versionamento, consistência de integrações, idempotência, retries, rate limit, etc.), garantindo escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Colaboração e Alinhamento Contínuo: Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis (refinamento, planning, review), contribuindo para clareza técnica, estimativas realistas e alinhamento entre produto, operações e desenvolvimento.
  • Qualidade e Segurança no Ciclo de Desenvolvimento: Reforçar práticas de code review, testes automatizados, análise estática e segurança (OWASP, gestão de segredos, IAM least privilege), garantindo qualidade do código e confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Uso de IA Generativa com Governança: Utilizar IA generativa para potencializar produtividade (análise de logs, geração/validação de testes, rascunho de documentação, scaffolding de código e refatorações assistidas), mantendo rigor em revisão humana, versionamento, padrões internos e práticas de segurança.
  • Mentoria e Multiplicação Técnica: Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time, com mentorias, revisão de PRs, suporte em decisões de design e disseminação de boas práticas para elevar o nível técnico do squad.
  • Desenvolvimento em Nuvem: Atuar em ambientes AWS (EC2, EKS, ECR, ACM, RDS), garantindo performance, escalabilidade e segurança.
  • Conteinerização e Orquestração: Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e Kubernetes (administração, criação de pods, serviços, ingress, etc.).
  • Integrações de Sistemas: Desenvolver integrações entre o assistente virtual e os sistemas dos clientes utilizando APIs REST e JSON, além de OpenAPI/Swagger.
  • Desenvolvimento Backend: Trabalhar principalmente com JavaScript, Node.js, Promises, HTML5, CSS e TypeScript para criar funcionalidades robustas e assíncronas de forma eficiente.
  • Autenticação e Segurança: Implementar autenticação com OIDC (OpenID Connect), SAML e aplicar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.
  • Criação e Manutenção de APIs: Desenvolver APIs internas e externas com documentação clara e padronizada.
  • Gestão de Bancos de Dados: Criar, administrar e otimizar bancos relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, MongoDB, RDS na AWS).
  • Ambiente Linux: Gerenciar e configurar servidores Linux, utilizando Shell Script para automação.
  • Controle de Versões: Utilizar Git para versionamento de código, integração contínua e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Desenvolvimento de Relatórios: Criar queries e relatórios para produtos e serviços.
  • Boas Práticas: Aplicar Promises, testes automatizados, documentação de código e metodologias ágeis para garantir escalabilidade e qualidade.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (filas, mensageria, processamento assíncrono) e padrões de resiliência.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada ao ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex.: geração de testes, revisão assistida, documentação automatizada) com governança e segurança.
  • Conhecimento em microserviços e arquitetura serverless.
  • Experiência com DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com IA Generativa para otimização de processos e experiência do usuário.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas (redes, firewalls, DNS, roteamento, modelagem de dados).
  • Experiência com Java ou Scala.
  • Desenvolvimento Full Stack: Atuar também em camadas de front-end sempre que necessário, garantindo a integração de ponta a ponta.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo 5 anos comprovados em desenvolvimento , essencialmente com JavaScript e Node.js.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos Imprescindíveis:
  • AWS (EC2, EKS/Kubernetes, ECR, ACM, RDS)
  • APIs REST e JSON
  • Git (controle de código e versionamento)
  • Linux (administração e Shell)
  • Promises e programação assíncrona em JavaScript
  • Práticas de desenvolvimento seguro e testes automatizados


Soft Skills e Competências Comportamentais

  • Tradução Negócio ↔ Técnica: Capacidade de entender rapidamente o contexto do cliente e transformar necessidades em soluções técnicas claras, alinhadas com prazos, riscos e impactos.
  • Senso de Dono e Pragmatismo: Foco em entregar valor com qualidade, escolhendo soluções sustentáveis e evitando complexidade desnecessária.
  • Organização e Comunicação Técnica: Saber conduzir refinamentos, registrar decisões e manter o time alinhado, garantindo transparência e clareza sobre escopo, riscos e dependências.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento técnico e de negócio.
  • Organização e Gestão de Prioridades: Capacidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e cumprir prazos.
  • Comunicação: Clareza e objetividade ao se comunicar com clientes e equipe interna.
  • Senso de Lógica e Criatividade: Resolver problemas de forma analítica, criando soluções robustas e escaláveis.

Regime híbrido: presencial até 3x por semana no escritório (próximo à Av. Paulista).

  • 2+ anos com Go (Golang) em produção
  • Domínio de arquitetura hexagonal (portas e adaptadores) — saber explicar e aplicar

DESEJÁVEL

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente do ramo bancário.

– Atuar em colaboração com a squad de desenvolvimento e sustentação em um ambiente que utiliza sistemas distribuídos, nuvem e o modelo DevOps.

– Desenvolver e manter aplicações web e APIs RESTfull, garantindo a alta disponibilidade e a performance dos sistemas.

– Aplicar as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software, como orientação a objetos, clean code e metodologias ágeis.

– Atender às áreas usuárias por meio da nossa central de serviços, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e reportando impedimentos.

– Experiência consolidada com desenvolvimento em C# e .NET Core.

– Conhecimentos em desenvolvimento front-end com HTML, CSS (responsivo), JavaScript e experiência com Single Page Applications (SPA);

– Vivência com desenvolvimento back-end utilizando ASP.NET Web Forms e ASP.NET MVC.

title: Operations Director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director


Introduction:

Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.


This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.


Compensation:

  • $40,000-90,000 USD per year.


Duties & Responsibilities:


Permitting

  • Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
  • Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
  • Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
  • Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
  • Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
  • Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.


Development Support

  • Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
  • File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.


Procurement

  • Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
  • Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
  • Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.


Transaction Support

  • Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
  • Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
  • Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.


Qualifications:

  • University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
  • Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
  • Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
  • Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
  • Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
  • Willing to be responsive and communicative.
  • Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST.
  • The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
  • Good attitude necessary.

A posição será responsável por atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das lideranças de Logística & Supply Chain, apoiando decisões relacionadas a pessoas, desenvolvimento organizacional e planejamento de força de trabalho, sempre em linha com os objetivos da operação.

O contexto exige boa leitura operacional, pragmatismo e capacidade de conectar desafios do negócio a soluções objetivas de RH.


O escopo envolve temas característicos do segmento, como operação 24/7, sazonalidade, alta rotatividade, produtividade e otimização de custos, além de atuação ao longo de todo o ciclo de gente, incluindo performance, desenvolvimento, engajamento e iniciativas de redução de turnover.

A posição também terá participação relevante em workforce planning, com construção e atualização de modelos de headcount, análise de indicadores e interface próxima com áreas como Operações, Finanças e Talent Acquisition.


Além disso, procuramos perfis que consigam trazer insights consistentes para o negócio e apoiar a Diretoria na reflexão estratégica sobre a área de Logística, contribuindo não apenas para a agenda de pessoas, mas também para discussões mais amplas sobre estrutura, eficiência e sustentabilidade da operação.

  • Construir e atualizar análises de workforce planning, headcount e dimensionamento de equipes, em interface com Operações, Finanças e Talent Acquisition.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de RH, propondo ações práticas e sustentáveis para melhoria dos resultados da operação.
  • Atuar de forma próxima às operações, entendendo o contexto local e apoiando a construção de soluções aderentes à realidade do negócio.
  • Contribuir com insights e recomendações para apoiar a Diretoria na definição de estratégias para a área de Logística.


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como HRBP ou em posições generalistas/analíticas de RH com vivência em ambientes de Logística, Supply Chain, Distribuição ou Operações.
  • Experiência em contextos operacionais com temas como turnover, produtividade, escalas e sazonalidade.
  • Capacidade de atuação consultiva com lideranças, sem perder profundidade na execução.

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior C# Developer to join a collaborative engineering team focused on enhancing Portfolio Management capabilities.


This role will partner closely with engineering, trading, risk, and operations teams to design and deliver scalable, high-performance solutions that improve portfolio transparency, accuracy, and operational efficiency across the firm. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in C#/.NET with a deep understanding of portfolio and position management concepts, and an interest in modern development practices including AI-enabled engineering and specification-driven development.


Responsibilities:

- Portfolio Management Enhancement

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve and extend portfolio management capabilities
  • Enhance portfolio aggregation, exposure calculation, and P&L reporting functionality
  • Improve intraday and end-of-day position workflows and controls
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives modernizing portfolio and position infrastructure


- Core Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services in C# / .NET
  • Contribute to the evolution of the Position Service architecture
  • Develop and enhance functionality within the Portfolio Management platform
  • Build scalable, resilient microservices supporting portfolio and order management workflows
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices


- AI & Intelligent Systems

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML and automation to enhance portfolio analytics, reconciliation, monitoring, and operational workflows
  • Collaborate on integrating AI-driven tools into the development lifecycle (e.g., intelligent code generation, review, testing, and documentation)
  • Contribute to the design of systems that enable advanced analytics and data-driven insights


- Specification-Driven Development


  • Promote and apply specification-driven development practices, including clear technical design documents and formalized functional requirements
  • Translate business requirements into precise system specifications prior to implementation
  • Ensure alignment between architecture, documentation, and delivered functionality
  • Improve development velocity and quality through stronger upfront design and validation processes


- System Design & Optimization


  • Improve system performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Optimize data processing pipelines and database interactions
  • Design and maintain robust APIs for internal consumers
  • Support both real-time and batch processing requirements


- Collaboration & Leadership


  • Work closely with portfolio managers, traders, risk, and operations teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Collaborate within the engineering team to drive architectural improvements
  • Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers
  • Promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong expertise in C# and .NET (Core/Framework).
  • Experience building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
  • Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.
  • Strong SQL and database design experience.
  • Experience with messaging systems and asynchronous programming.
  • Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.
  • Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, and cost optimization
  • Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong team player.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.


English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Vaga: Senior Analytics Engineer | Data Engineering & Power BI — PJ (Remoto)


Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Analytics Engineer para atuar na evolução do nosso ecossistema de dados, conectando engenharia, modelagem analítica e visualização de informações. A posição requer um perfil com forte base técnica, capaz de transformar dados brutos em soluções confiáveis para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica.


Resumo da Posição:

O(a) profissional será responsável por estruturar e otimizar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT), organizar camadas analíticas escaláveis e desenvolver dashboards executivos em Power BI. Atuará na ponte entre a engenharia e o negócio, garantindo a consistência de métricas e KPIs corporativos, além de disseminar as melhores práticas de modelagem e cultura data-driven.


Principais Atividades:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) integrando múltiplas fontes.
  • Realizar transformação e tratamento de dados complexos utilizando SQL e Python.
  • Participar da definição de arquitetura de dados e implementação de melhores práticas técnicas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados (Star Schema / Snowflake) para consumo em BI e self-service analytics.

  • Desenvolver métricas e KPIs garantindo a padronização e consistência entre as áreas.

  • Apoiar na estruturação de processos que garantam a integridade da informação.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com stakeholders para traduzir necessidades de negócio em produtos de dados.
  • Gerar insights acionáveis e apoiar a evolução da cultura analítica na organização.
  • Facilitar o uso de dados pelas áreas através de soluções intuitivas e governadas.


Requisitos Técnicos Imprescindíveis

  • Experiência sólida em Analytics Engineering, Engenharia de Dados ou BI.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL e Python para manipulação de dados.
  • Experiência profunda com Power BI (DAX, Power Query, modelagem e performance).
  • Sólida vivência com modelagem dimensional (Star Schema / Snowflake).
  • Experiência com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e Data Warehouses.
  • Conhecimento em processos de integração de dados e ETL/ELT.


Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex: Apache Airflow).
  • Conhecimento em Spark ou processamento distribuído.
  • Vivência com BigQuery, Redshift ou Synapse.
  • Experiência com Git, CI/CD e práticas de DataOps.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de governança e qualidade de dados.


Habilidades Pessoais (Soft Skills)

  • Visão analítica e foco em solução de problemas.
  • Excelente capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas.
  • Perfil colaborativo, organizado e com senso de dono (ownership).
  • Boa comunicação para trânsito entre times técnicos e executivos.


Modelo de Trabalho

  • Modelo remoto, com possível possibilidade de participar de reuniões presenciais ou ir ao escritório do cliente (São Paulo, SP)
  • Contratação PJ


Benefícios ATRA

  • TotalPass
  • Reembolso 100% em certificações
  • Parcerias educacionais
  • Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas
  • Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:

Nós lhe propomos:

title: ServiceNow EC Pro Product Manager
description:
We are looking for a skilled Technology EC Pro Product Manager with expertise in the ServiceNow platform to join our product management team. The successful candidate will analyse customer requirements, product performance and future road map within the ServiceNow ecosystem to help deliver business value and optimise our ServiceNow-based solutions. This role requires a strong understanding of ServiceNow combined with analytical and excellent communication skills.


What are we looking for?

  • 4+ years of experience in product analysis, business analysis, or product management focused on ServiceNow or similar platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field.
  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow modules such as Employee Center, ITSM, ITOM, SPM, HRSD, CSM)
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and product management tools
  • Excellent communication skills to bridge technical and business teams.
  • Ability to translate complex ServiceNow technical features into business value propositions.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


What will be your key responsibilities?


  • ServiceNow Product Management
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of ServiceNow platform capabilities, modules and third-party integrations to identify enhancement opportunities and competitive positioning.
  • Customer and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external customers to gather detailed requirements and feedback related to ServiceNow implementations and customisations.
  • Data-Driven Insights
  • Analyse usage data, feedback trends, and service metrics within ServiceNow to assess product effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
  • External Trends
  • Stay current with ServiceNow product updates, industry trends to inform product roadmap and innovation strategies.
  • Requirements Documentation and Prioritisation
  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories for development teams working on ServiceNow enhancements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with ServiceNow developers, user research & design architects, IT operations, and service line product owners to ensure alignment on product goals and successful delivery of ServiceNow solutions.
  • Reporting and Communication
  • Prepare dashboards, reports, and presentations on ServiceNow product performance, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction for leadership and stakeholders.
  • Support Product Lifecycle
  • Assist in testing new ServiceNow features, validating custom workflows, and ensuring quality and compliance with organisational standards.


What Can You Expect from Mars?


  • Work with over 140,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus

title: Executivo de vendas B2B (Closer)
description:
Sobre a Cogni

A Cogni desenvolve software para gestão de créditos de energia, ajudando empresas do setor a ganhar escala, controle operacional e eficiência por meio de tecnologia.


Estamos em expansão e buscamos um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas B2B (Closer) para conduzir oportunidades comerciais de forma consultiva, transformando leads qualificados em novos clientes.


Sobre a vaga

Buscamos alguém com experiência em vendas B2B consultivas, capaz de conduzir reuniões com decisores, entender cenários operacionais complexos, apresentar valor com clareza e avançar negociações até o fechamento.

Não estamos buscando alguém para apenas “apresentar produto”. Procuramos alguém que saiba investigar problema, construir percepção de valor, lidar com objeções e conduzir oportunidades com método.


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais com leads qualificados
  • Entender o contexto operacional, comercial e decisório de cada oportunidade
  • Realizar diagnóstico de necessidades e aderência da solução
  • Apresentar a Cogni de forma consultiva, conectando produto e dor real do cliente
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais e conduzir negociações
  • Fazer follow-up com consistência e qualidade
  • Avançar oportunidades ao longo do funil até o fechamento
  • Manter CRM atualizado com clareza, critério e disciplina
  • Interagir com marketing, pré-vendas e liderança para melhorar ICP, discurso e processo comercial
  • Devolver inteligência sobre objeções recorrentes, concorrência e maturidade do mercado


O que esperamos

  • Experiência prévia com vendas software/SaaS B2B
  • Boa condução de reunião comercial e descoberta de necessidades
  • Capacidade de falar com decisores e influenciadores
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Organização de pipeline e disciplina em follow-up
  • Capacidade de negociação sem depender de desconto como muleta
  • Facilidade para aprender contexto técnico e de negócio
  • Perfil consultivo, analítico e executor


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com ticket médio relevante ou venda complexa
  • Experiência em energia, utilities, geração distribuída ou mercados correlatos
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento de metas


Modelo de trabalho

  • Remoto. Se próximo a Goiânia-GO, pode trabalhar presencialmente em nosso escritório, caso prefira!
  • Regime: CLT
  • Faixa salarial: fixo (entre R$ 5.000 - 6.000) + variável por performance


O que será considerado um bom desempenho

  • Conversão consistente de oportunidades qualificadas em clientes
  • Boa condução de pipeline e previsibilidade comercial
  • Baixo desperdício de oportunidade por falta de follow-up ou condução fraca
  • CRM útil, atualizado e confiável
  • Feedback consistente sobre mercado, discurso e produto


Candidatura

  • Se você já vendeu em contexto B2B consultivo, sabe conduzir oportunidade com método e quer crescer em uma empresa de tecnologia aplicada ao setor de energia, candidate-se.

Somos uma empresa brasileira referência em inovação no setor aeronáutico, com crescimento acelerado e presença internacional. •Definir processos produtivos para novos desenvolvimentos;

•Atuar em conjunto com equipe multidisciplinar (mecânica, elétrica e automação);

•Mentalidade de engenheiro criador de produto, não apenas desenhista;

•Forte capacidade de pensamento sistêmico e resolução de problemas;

•Proatividade e senso de dono;

•Organização e boa comunicação;

•Interesse genuíno por inovação, robótica e automação.

•Domínio em modelagem 3D no SolidWorks (nível avançado);

•Inglês intermediário;

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas valorizados)

•Experiência com AGVs, robótica ou automação industrial;

•Conhecimento em sistemas elétricos/eletrônicos aplicados a máquinas;

•Vivência em desenvolvimento de produtos inovadores ou patenteáveis.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Multidisciplinary Creative
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, versatile Multidisciplinary Creative who can move fluidly across video, design, UI/UX, and AI, and make it all look effortless.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an \"unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You'll Do


  • Edit and produce video content across formats, social, brand, campaign, and everything in between.
  • Design compelling visual assets across digital and print, maintaining brand consistency and creative quality.
  • Lead and execute UI/UX work, from wireframes and user flows to polished, production-ready interfaces.
  • Leverage AI tools to enhance and accelerate creative output, from ideation to execution.
  • Collaborate with strategists, account managers, and developers to bring creative concepts to life across multiple channels.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously without dropping the ball on quality or deadlines.
  • Stay ahead of design trends, tools, and AI-powered workflows that keep our creative output cutting edge.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience across graphic design, video editing, and UI/UX, not just one of them.
  • A strong portfolio that proves you can move across disciplines without losing quality.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop), Figma, and Canva.
  • Real experience using AI tools in a creative workflow (image generation, video AI, copy assistance, etc.).
  • A solid eye for typography, layout, motion, and user experience.
  • Ability to take creative direction and run with it independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills, you know how to present your work and take feedback like a pro.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with Webflow or basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS).
  • Motion graphics or animation experience beyond basic video editing.
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Familiarity with AI design tools like Midjourney, ElevenLabs, or equivalents.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you're someone who thrives on variety, gets excited by creative challenges across multiple disciplines, and loves using the latest tools to push work further, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

title: Database Administrator
description:
As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

description:

As principais responsabilidades incluem atividades diárias de recebimento e envio de produtos, organização e embalagem de mercadorias, e controle de estoque. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer trabalho presencial.

1 - Emissão e acompanhamento de pedidos (B2B e B2C)

Monitoramento integral dos pedidos nos canais B2B e B2C, desde o faturamento até a confirmação de entrega pelo transportador, garantindo rastreabilidade e conformidade em cada etapa do processo logístico.

2 - Geração de etiquetas de envio

Emissão de etiquetas de despacho para os Correios e demais transportadoras parceiras, assegurando a correta atribuição de dados de remetente, destinatário, peso e modalidade de serviço.

3 - Montagem e preparação de itens para embarque

Separação, conferência e montagem dos itens a serem despachados, incluindo organização de kits, acondicionamento adequado das mercadorias e verificação da conformidade entre os produtos e os pedidos correspondentes, prior ao envio.

4 - Despacho de mercadorias

Execução do processo de despacho junto aos Correios e transportadoras, incluindo entrega física dos volumes, coleta de comprovantes de postagem, controle dos protocolos de envio e registro nos sistemas internos.

5 - Tratativas de extravio e ocorrências logísticas

Abertura, acompanhamento e resolução de ocorrências de extravio junto às transportadoras, com registro das tratativas e acionamento das áreas envolvidas para minimizar o impacto ao cliente final.

6 - Monitoramento de pedidos rejeitados

Identificação, análise e tratamento de pedidos recusados ou devolvidos, mapeando as causas de rejeição e adotando as medidas corretivas necessárias para reprocessamento ou cancelamento.

7 - Monitoramento de retiradas via Mandaê

Acompanhamento das coletas agendadas pela plataforma Mandaê, verificando confirmações de retirada, status de despacho e eventuais pendências operacionais.

8 - Atendimento de solicitações especiais de envio

Atendimento e controle das demandas de envio recebidas por e-mail, incluindo remessas para atletas, patrocinados, eventos e parceiros estratégicos, respeitando prazos e especificações acordados.

9 - Atendimento de demandas via canais de comunicação internos e externos

Acompanhamento e resolução das solicitações recebidas nos canais de comunicação internos e externos, garantindo respostas ágeis e alinhadas aos fluxos operacionais.

10 - Recebimento e conferência de notas fiscais

Recebimento, validação e registro das notas fiscais de entrada, verificando a conformidade dos dados fiscais e a correspondência com os pedidos de compra emitidos.

11 - Recebimento e conferência de produtos

Participação no processo de recebimento físico de mercadorias, conferindo quantidades, integridade das embalagens e conformidade com os documentos fiscais e pedidos correspondentes.

title: Backend Engineer – Retail Integrations
description:
Company Description

RxDiet is a healthcare technology company that provides medically tailored groceries and clinical behavioral health interventions for patients. Our proprietary artificial intelligence and national grocery retail integrations allow us to deliver these solutions to patients, meeting them where they are. Our mission is to empower members' healthcare journeys by unlocking the full potential of food as medicine.


Role Description

We are looking for a Backend Engineer – Retail Integrations to take ownership of our integrations with third-party retailers in the United States. You will work closely with the engineering and devops team. This is a do-it-all role, and we need an individual who wants to get their hands dirty. This role is full-time remote.


What we are looking for:

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience, with Kotlin as the primary language; strong Java experience is considered if paired with a genuine interest in adopting Kotlin.
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot and production-grade application development.
  • Strong command of authentication and authorization patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys, token lifecycle management) across a range of integration architectures.
  • Proficiency working with both REST and GraphQL APIs, including handling underdocumented or evolving third-party interfaces.
  • Experience designing and working within microservices architectures, including asynchronous communication via Apache ActiveMQ.
  • Hands-on experience with frontend reverse engineering and web scraping, including browser automation tools such as Puppeteer or Playwright.
  • Experience integrating with grocery or food retailer APIs (order management, product catalogs, availability, or fulfillment) is a strong competitive advantage.
  • General AWS knowledge including S3, and familiarity with core AWS services and best practices.
  • General frontend knowledge and familiarity with modern frameworks (React, Vue, or similar).
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage time effectively.
  • Ready to respond to outages and troubleshoot issues quickly when things break.
  • It's a bonus if you're interested in food-as-medicine, startups, or community health.


Our Perks


  • Competitive salary structure.
  • Full flexibility for remote work (Work from anywhere).
  • One annual company-wide offsite event.
  • Unlimited time off policy.
  • Be an integral part of a supportive, collaborative, and mission-driven team culture.


RxDiet is an Equal Opportunity Employer and strives to create a diverse and inclusive environment. We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and are committed to non-discrimination in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

description:

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.

  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Gerente de segurança da informação
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG.


Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais.


Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro.


Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas!

Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!


Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.


Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional.


Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua.


Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Principais atividades:


  • Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização.
  • Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros.
  • Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos.
  • Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS).
  • Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança.
  • Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura.
  • Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais.
  • Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura.
  • Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral.
  • Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos.
  • Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores.
  • Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins
  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos
  • Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR)


Conhecimento específicos:


  • Políticas de segurança
  • Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social.
  • Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos
  • Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização
  • Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido)

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Investment Team Analyst / Intern
description:
Company Description


Upstream Capital is a tactical investor focused on growth-stage technology companies, deploying both debt and equity to scale businesses. Headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, the firm has a global reach, with a proven track record of investing over $200 million in over 25 tech companies across Latin America, the Bay Area, and other regions. With deep expertise in the tech sector, Upstream Capital operates as a comprehensive finance platform leveraging knowledge, networking, data, and AI to drive success. The company is committed to partnering with innovative businesses, finding creative solutions to complex challenges, and aligning success between investors and investees for long-term growth.


Role Description


The role is designed for someone who is deeply curious about how companies operate, how their economics work, and what are the patterns that makes some of them thrive. The Intern will be exposed to the full investment process and encouraged to think critically about markets and capital allocation.

Beyond analytical work, we value people who enjoy engaging with the broader investment landscape. The role involves listening, asking good questions, forming independent views, and contributing ideas to internal discussions. Curiosity and judgment matter as much as technical skills.

Upstream operates in a lean, high-ownership environment. Interns are expected to take responsibility for their work, explore opportunities proactively, and learn by doing. We look for individuals who are comfortable navigating ambiguity and who see feedback and mistakes as part of the learning process.

Candidates may come from any academic background. What matters is intellectual rigor, attention to detail, and a consistent pattern of high personal standards. Prior exposure to finance, consulting, or technology is a plus, but not a prerequisite.


Qualifications


  • Proficiency in Financial Modeling and deep understanding of Finance principles
  • Ability to communicate insights effectively through reports and presentations
  • Experience in, or knowledge of, the technology sector is a plus
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is strongly preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field


About Us

Formerly known as Upload Ventures Growth, Upstream has the goal of becoming a platform for lifecycle investing in growth and late-stage technology companies. The firm builds on Upload’s track record of supporting global founders and leverages its experience in venture capital, technology, and data to identify, underwrite, and scale high-performing businesses.


Upstream operates with a lean structure and a hands-on approach. We value analytical rigor, operational discipline, and the ability to execute with precision in fast-paced environments.

description:
Job Title: Lead Generation Specialist
