About the role:

In this role, you will create and execute high-impact demand generation programs across the Brazilian market. You will harness data and intent to engage buying groups across key areas such as Training, System Certification, ISA, and Digital Trust, adapting global strategies for local realities. You'll also partner closely with Sales Directors and the Global Digital Hub to convert interest into opportunities.


If you’re a bilingual/tri-lingual, hands-on strategist who thrives in a matrixed environment, come and build the engine that feeds our pipeline across Latin America.


What you will own:

  • Regional demand strategy: Define the LATAM demand plan tied to MQL, SQL, and opportunity targets by country, sector, and persona.
  • Multi-channel execution: Launch integrated programs across email, /paid social, paid search, webinars/events, and content syndication, localized for Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Sales partnership: Build target account lists and joint GTM plans with Sales Directors; enable teams with localized ABM playbooks and content.
  • Tech + intent: Operationalize ABM/intent platforms (e.g., Bombora, Demandbase/6sense/RollWorks) and convert signals into orchestrated journeys.
  • Attribution discipline: Drive clean segmentation, routing, UTM/tagging, and reporting with digital operations.


How you’ll execute:

  • Localization that performs: Tailor narratives to local regulations, industries, and buyer behavior; ensure cultural nuance in copy and creative.
  • Cross-functional sync: Coordinate with field marketing, content, and ops to deliver on time and on brand via Workfront.


How you’ll measure success:

  • Demand quality: MQLs, SAL/SQL conversion, pipeline contribution, opportunities created.
  • Channel economics: CPL/CAC, influenced revenue, multi-touch attribution.
  • Operational health: Launch timeliness, rework reduction, attribution accuracy (UTM coverage).


What you bring:

  • ABM and demand expertise across segmentation, lead scoring, and personalized content delivery.
  • Martech fluency: Salesforce, Pardot (or Marketo), Workfront; hands-on with ABM/intent tools (Demandbase, 6sense, RollWorks, Bombora, Apollo).
  • Experience in building dashboards, reading patterns, and prioritizing optimizations.
  • Strong collaborator across countries, time zones, and stakeholders; crisp communicator.
  • An organized and detail-oriented approach
  • Confidence in managing multiple campaigns at one time.
  • A growth mindset with proactive problem-solving skills.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • Experience in B2B demand gen/digital/ABM with measurable campaign success (professional services, SaaS, or regulated industries preferred).
  • Experience in matrixed/global organizations and familiarity with B2B buyer journeys.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Pardot, Workfront, and ABM platforms.


Language & travel:

  • Languages: Strong command of English and Portuguese both verbal and written.
  • Travel may be required to attend events.


Additional information:

Please submit your resume in English.


BSI - Your Partner in Progress

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organizations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, United Kingdom, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


If you want to contribute to this inspiring challenge, bring your open and enthusiastic mindset to our dynamic team then please apply now!


Our benefits:

We offer a competitive salary plus; 30-days annual leave, paid sick leave, bank holidays, health insurance, life insurance, public transport allowance, meal allowance, vacation bonus, paid maternity leave, paid paternity leave, paid marriage leave, paid military service leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

title: Founder's Associate
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.**


A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays.


You want something else. Something you build yourself.


We have that.


---


### Who we are


Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work.


The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year.


Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.


---


### The role: Founder's Associate


You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week.


In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different:


- One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.

- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.

- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.

- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week.


The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.


---


### Your first 30 days


- **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.

- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.

- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.

- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it.


By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.


---


### What you get (beyond salary)


**Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration.


**Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time.


**Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.


---


### Where this role can take you


In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths:


- **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook

- **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works

- **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.


---


### Who we're looking for


You:


- Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation**

- Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field**

- Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent)

- **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist.


And also:


- **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.

- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.

- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.

- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.

- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.

- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how.


You've probably already turned down a \"stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.


---


### The honest deal


We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job.


We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have.


In return we give:


- **Competitive PJ salary.**

- **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.


---


### This is NOT for you if


- You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day

- You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes

- You want to be a specialist in one thing

- You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet

- You want an impressive title more than real impact

- You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time

- You expect promotions based on tenure


If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.


---


### How to apply


Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question:


**\"Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\"**


Be specific. We want the actual story.

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

Regulamentações e Normas

  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.

  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS

Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Position Overview:

As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‑generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‑first operations, and AI‑driven decision‑making across the organization.


You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.


Responsibilities:

  • Administers day‑to‑day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance.
  • Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams.
  • Partners with cross‑functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows.
  • Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements.
  • Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health.
  • Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‑powered workflow automations.
  • Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‑channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations.
  • Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience.
  • Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling.
  • Ensures secure, least‑privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs.
  • Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment.
  • Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement.
  • Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools.
  • Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‑scaling teams.
  • Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‑to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance.


Position Requirements:

  • 4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‑level or high‑velocity environment.
  • Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred.
  • Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel.


Additional Requirements:

  • Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.
  • Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred).
  • Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
  • Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‑functional GTM operations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
  • Hands‑on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)
  • Define and document API contracts and data schemas in collaboration with mobile developers
  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Develop and maintain backend test suites; collaborate with SDETs on integration testing
  • Maintain JIRA user stories and technical tasks for backend workstream
  • Monitor service health, diagnose production issues, and lead root cause analysis
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java, Node.js (TypeScript), Python, or Go
  • Strong experience designing and building RESTful APIs for mobile clients
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Familiarity with JIRA for backlog and sprint management
  • Understanding of security practices: OAuth, JWT, HTTPS, input validation
  • Experience with automated testing and integration with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong commitment to Test Driven Development (TDD) practices for backend service quality
  • Experience building backends specifically optimized for mobile (bandwidth-efficient, low-latency APIs)
  • Familiarity with push notification infrastructure (FCM, APNs)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
  • Exposure to GraphQL API design

Regime 100% Home Office.

Tempo indeterminado.

Requisito obrigatório: Disponibilidade para participar de certificação internacional , etapa indispensável para atuação na posição.


COMO FUNCIONA O MODELO DE ATUAÇÃO

1. Estrutura comercial e administrativa centralizada

A ActionCOACH é responsável pela geração de oportunidades, condução comercial, fechamento de contratos, cobrança e rotinas administrativas. Isso permite que o(a) consultor(a) concentre sua energia na entrega, no relacionamento com os clientes e na evolução dos resultados.

O papel central do(a) consultor(a) é apoiar empresários por meio de uma metodologia validada, contribuindo para a construção de laboratórios mais organizados, rentáveis, estruturados e menos dependentes do dono.

SOBRE A ACTIONCOACH

A ActionCOACH é a maior empresa de business coaching do mundo, presente em mais de 80 países e com mais de 30 anos de atuação global.

O escritório de Santa Catarina atua há mais de 18 anos no Brasil, com histórico consistente no desenvolvimento de empresários e empresas de pequeno e médio porte.

title: Cloudbees DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloudbees DevOps Engineer – Help Shape the Future of Continuous Delivery at a Global Financial Technology Leader!


Join a mission-critical engineering organisation at the heart of one of the world’s most influential financial messaging and payments platforms. Become part of a global DevOps Engineering Services team enabling modern software delivery, automation, and orchestration across a highly complex, secure, and fast-moving technology landscape. This is your opportunity to work inside a global organisation transforming the way software is built, released, and operated - while collaborating with senior engineers and DevOps experts across continents.

As a DevOps Engineer within the DevOps Engineering Services team, you’ll help deliver internal tooling, automation, and release orchestration capabilities that empower hundreds of developers and application teams.

Working in a transversal function, you’ll support the rollout and optimisation of CloudBees Release Orchestration (RO) and CI/CD best practices, ensuring smooth adoption and consistent execution across the organisation. You'll contribute to a mature programme governed by senior engineers, with clear guidance, structured delivery, and high-impact outcomes across enterprise DevOps environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Support adoption of CI/CD and RO tooling across internal DevOps teams

  • Enable best practices for Git workflows, artefact management (Nexus), and code quality (SonarQube)

  • Support containerisation initiatives using Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Collaborate in an Agile, DevSecOps-driven environment to standardise delivery processes

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of DevOps engineering experience
  • Hands-on expertise with CI/CD tooling, ideally CloudBees.
  • Hands on experience with Jenkins, Git, Nexus, SonarQube
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools
  • Practical development experience in Java/Maven or C++
  • Exposure to infrastructure automation using Python and Ansible
  • Knowledge of containerisation: Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of Agile and DevSecOps principles
  • Excellent English communication skills (client teams are primarily US-based)

Why Join the Remobi Community

  • 100% remote B2B/freelance contracts

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno/Sênior – Com ênfase em Novos Negócios
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos uma empresa inovadora e comprometida com a excelência na gestão e operação de infraestruturas da área de educação e saúde. Atuamos com foco na sustentabilidade, segurança e eficiência. Buscamos um Analista de Planejamento Financeiro para integrar nossa equipe, oferecendo uma excelente oportunidade de crescimento profissional e aprendizado em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador.


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Analista Financeiro (nível Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar de forma hands-on na estruturação e análise financeira de novos negócios , incluindo concessões/PPPs, projetos greenfield e iniciativas corporativas . O papel envolve desde a orçamentação do projeto, modelagem econômico‑financeira e avaliação de viabilidade até a preparação de materiais executivos para Comitês e stakeholders. Este papel se conecta diretamente ao nosso pipeline de projetos de infraestrutura social.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Participar da construção do Orçamento OPEX dos projetos e acompanhar a equipe de Engenharia na mensuração do orçamento CAPEX , fazendo a consolidação dos orçamentos dos projetos.
  • Montar planilhas de Modelagem econômico‑financeira (fluxos de caixa, VPL, TIR, payback, cenários/sensibilidades) de projetos de novos negócios e projetos em execução (PPP/concessões, contratos de longo prazo e projetos corporativos).
  • Estruturar e atualizar business cases : premissas de CAPEX/OPEX, receitas, índices, tributos e alavancas de valor; preparar cadernos de viabilidade e apresentações executivas para Comitês e parceiros.
  • Apoiar processos de funding : interação com bancos , envio de dossiês, abertura de contas e adequações cadastrais; acompanhar cronogramas financeiros e condições precedentes.
  • Contribuir em due diligences (financeira/tributária/operacional) e em RFPs/edital : leitura crítica de minutas, consolidação de insumos, checklists e alinhamento com áreas internas/assessorias.
  • Construir e acompanhar a programação/controle de caixa dos projetos, comparando real x previsto e suportando revisões de projeção.
  • Preparar materiais para governança (relatórios econômico‑financeiros, memoriais de cálculo, Q&As) e apoiar interfaces com consultorias externas quando aplicável.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em modelagem financeira de projetos (valuation, VPL/TIR, cenários) e planejamento financeiro .
  • Vivência em novos negócios/infraestrutura/concessões ou projetos de longo prazo.
  • Domínio de Excel em nível Avançado (modelagem, cenários, auditoria de planilhas).
  • Capacidade de comunicação executiva (elaboração de dossiês e apresentações para Comitês/alta gestão).


Diferenciais que contam pontos

  • Passagem por projetos de PPP/concessões ;
  • Experiência na elaboração do orçamento OPEX para projetos de concessão.


Competências comportamentais

  • Pensamento analítico e senso crítico , com disciplina para traduzir números em decisões.
  • Organização e priorização em ambientes com múltiplos stakeholders e prazos.
  • Colaboração com áreas multifuncionais (engenharia, operações, RH. etc.).
  • Proatividade e dono(a) do negócio) : autonomia para aprofundar premissas e propor alavancas de valor.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level?


At Qencode, we’re not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we’re redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we’re shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video.


We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator who’s eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you’ll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. It’s an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills fast, wear multiple hats, and learn how marketing works end-to-end in a dynamic startup environment.



Your Goals

  • Build and launch email campaigns in HubSpot (newsletters, product updates, nurture sequences).
  • Manage and schedule social media content across , X, and other channels.
  • Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages).
  • Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts.
  • Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners.


Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count).
  • Familiarity with marketing automation tools (ie: HubSpot).
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment.



Benefits

  • Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team.
  • Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded.
  • Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video.
  • Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path.
  • 100% Remote position working with a global team.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit.


About Us

Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

Você vai atuar como líder de um dos principais times de frontend da Remessa Online , que é o time de B2C , responsável pelas nossas plataformas PF Web e Mobile .

Todo o time de engenharia participa ativamente das cerimônias ágeis e também das discussões de arquitetura das soluções . Aqui a gente respira regras de negócio e tem muita paixão pelo que faz. Usamos isso para construir, estruturar e evoluir nossos serviços cada vez mais.

Por isso, é importante ter resiliência e facilidade para lidar com mudanças de cenário .

Também valorizamos muito documentação técnica , melhorias constantes no codebase e estamos sempre abertos a novas ideias e soluções fora da caixa , até mesmo para problemas simples.


No dia a dia você vai:

  • Gerenciar um time de desenvolvimento de software em um ambiente ágil, usando métricas de produtividade e com foco em resultados.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de carreira dos desenvolvedores do time, realizando 1:1 frequentes e feedbacks contínuos .

title: Server Manager (Global Project)
description:

Nesta função, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos, solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.

  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.

  • Expertise em Linux: Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu. É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível.

Oferecemos acesso a posições de alto nível, remuneração competitiva, benefícios atrativos e treinamentos online gratuitos. Estamos construindo uma comunidade de criadores UGC para ajudar a contar essa história.


Sobre a Comunidade de Criadores UGC

Estamos procurando criadores de conteúdo para redes sociais para se juntarem à nossa Comunidade de Criadores UGC do Pure — um grupo que produz vídeos curtos (TikTok / Instagram) sobre temas como namoro, confiança, amor-próprio, entre outros.

Como criador, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com o nosso time, desenvolver sua marca pessoal e ser pago para criar conteúdos autênticos e envolventes que desafiam a forma como as pessoas enxergam o namoro.


O que você vai fazer
  • Criar e postar 7 vídeos curtos por semana (TikTok / Instagram Reels / YouTube Shorts, etc.)
  • Desenvolver conteúdos inspirados em namoro, conexões e autoexpressão
  • Direcionar pessoas para o app
  • Participar de briefings criativos, tendências e campanhas
  • Receber feedback e orientação para melhorar sua performance
  • Colaborar com o time em ideias de storytelling e estratégias sociais


O que buscamos
  • Você deve estar baseado no Brasil e ser fluente em português
  • Paixão por storytelling, redes sociais e cultura contemporânea
  • Familiaridade com tendências do TikTok, formatos de Reels e conteúdo UGC
  • Boa presença em frente às câmeras e habilidades de edição
  • Consistência e capacidade de cumprir metas semanais de conteúdo
  • Mente aberta e conforto para criar conteúdos sobre namoro e relacionamentos


Estrutura de pagamento
  • Estrutura por níveis com pagamento semanal
  • Bônus por visualizações (a partir de 100 mil views)
  • Bônus por registros
  • Pagamentos realizados semanalmente
Por que se juntar a nós
  • Seja pago para criar conteúdo autêntico sobre namoro e autoexpressão
  • Acesso a orientação criativa, briefings e uma rede global de criadores
  • Construa seu portfólio enquanto colabora com a gente
  • Liberdade criativa — seu estilo, sua história, sua perspectiva

    • Como se candidatar

    Envie sua carta de apresentação e conte um pouco sobre você, incluindo por que gostaria de trabalhar com o app Pure.

    Você será convidado para uma call de onboarding em grupo e receberá uma tarefa para criar um vídeo de teste.

    Depois disso, você entrará em um período de teste de 2 semanas e, se for aprovado, será totalmente integrado ao programa.

    As candidaturas são analisadas de forma contínua.

title: Analista financeiro II (Financial Analyst)
description:
Sax Trading ( is Hiring a Mid/ Sr Financial Analyst to work full time as an independent contractor.


The ideal candidate will be responsible for using their analytical mindset to analyze and interpret financial data, then relating it to potential business trends and issues. This candidate will feel comfortable using insights they have discovered to communicate important themes and discoveries to company leadership. 

Responsibilities

  • Financial planning: Preparation of budgets, financial projections, and short- and long-term strategic plans. Cash flow control: Monitoring of resources inflows and outflows, ensuring the company's liquidity. 
  • Feasibility analysis: Assessment of investments, projects, and initiatives to determine their profitability and financial impact. 
  •  Management of financial indicators: Tracking KPIs (such as profit margin, ROI, EBITDA) to evaluate financial performance. 
  •  Negotiation with financial institutions: Management of relationships with banks, fundraising, and debt administration. 
  •  Accounting supervision: Ensuring the correct preparation of balance sheets, income statements (DRE), and other accounting reports. 
  •  Compliance with accounting standards: Ensuring that accounting practices are aligned with CPC (Accounting Pronouncements Committee) and IFRS (international standards).
  • Accounting closing: Coordination of monthly, quarterly, and annual closings, ensuring the accuracy of information.
  • Cost management: Analysis and control of operational costs, identifying opportunities for reduction and efficiency improvement.
  • Tax planning: Development of strategies to optimize the tax burden, complying with current legislation.
  • Tax compliance: Ensuring fulfillment of tax obligations, such as submission of declarations (SPED, ECD, ECF) and payment of taxes (ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, etc.).
  •  Management of tax risks: Identification and mitigation of risks related to tax assessments or non-compliance.
  •  Monitoring legal changes: Tracking changes in tax legislation to adapt the company's processes.


Qualifications

  • English (C1)- Due report abroad

title: Analista Comercial

Buscamos um(a) profissional colaborativo(a), proativo(a), com fortes habilidades analíticas e operacionais, que goste de atuar na interseção entre vendas, dados e atendimento ao cliente.

Na OUP, você fará parte de uma organização orientada por propósito, que une excelência acadêmica, inovação e impacto global. Oferecemos um ambiente colaborativo, oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento, e a chance de contribuir para a educação em escala mundial.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Global Networks Leader
description:
Purpose


As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services.


Main Responsibilities


Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance.


Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations.


Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.


Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.


Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making.


Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.


Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity.


Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements.


Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits.


Knowledge and experience requiered


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish
  • In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.
  • Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
  • Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment.
  • Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.g., Ansible, Python).


Management & communication Skills


  • Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.g., operations, finance, senior management).


Relevant Experience


  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations.

title: Data Engineer III
description:
Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.


O que você fará

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.

Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.

Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.


Qualificações Mínimas

• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.

• Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

• Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.

• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

• Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.

• Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.

• Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

• Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

• Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos.

• Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.

• Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).

• Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.

• Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).

• Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

title: Full Stack Web Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta oportunidade irá atender um de nossos clientes globais do segmento de óleo e gás, com atuação em projetos estratégicos e de grande escala, em um ambiente altamente tecnológico e com interação internacional.

Oportunidade para atuar com desenvolvimento Full Stack em aplicações modernas, envolvendo arquitetura escalável, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web e atuação em ambientes cloud.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web full stack (frontend e backend)
  • Construir e consumir APIs REST utilizando .NET (C#)
  • Desenvolver interfaces responsivas com Angular e/ou Vue.js
  • Atuar com deploy e gestão de aplicações em cloud (Azure e/ou AWS)
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD e versionamento com Git
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento (clean code, testes, design patterns)
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em ambiente ágil

Dependendo do projeto, você também poderá atuar com:

  • Integração de APIs
  • Containerização com Docker
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform)



O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência como Full Stack Web Developer em ambiente produtivo
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em C# e .NET (APIs REST)
  • Experiência com Angular (TypeScript) e/ou Vue.js / AngularJS
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure ou AWS)
  • Vivência com Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Conhecimentos em HTML, CSS e JavaScript
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com times globais



Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Vivência com CI/CD (build, testes e deploy)
  • Experiência com Docker (containerização)
  • Conhecimento em Terraform ou outras ferramentas de IaC
  • Experiência com manutenção e evolução de aplicações

You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

ARQUITETO CONSULTOR DE DADOS

(Enterprise Architecture | Hybrid & Multi-Cloud)


A Copel busca um Arquiteto Consultor de Dados de alto nível para liderar a modernização e a governança de um ecossistema complexo e distribuído. O desafio exige orquestrar uma arquitetura que integra o core no GCP com sistemas críticos em AWS, OCI (SAP S/4) e infraestruturas On-premises, garantindo uma transição fluida para modelos de Data Mesh/Data Fabric e Lakehouse, sempre sob os rigorosos padrões da Arquitetura Corporativa (TOGAF). Conhecimento e vivência na construção de Data Produtos.


ESCOPO DE ATUAÇÃO E RESPONSABILIDADES:

Design de Arquitetura Híbrida (On-premise & Cloud): Projetar e gerenciar a integração entre o legado físico e a nuvem, garantindo a integridade do dado.

Governança e Modelos de Entrega: Implementar o paradigma de Data Mesh e modelos Hub-and-Spoke, provendo ambientes de Sandbox seguros e estruturas de consumo para produtos de dados.

Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Definir e acompanhar métricas de saúde de infraestrutura e pipelines, garantindo visibilidade total sobre a operação.

Modernização Real-Time (Stream): Implementar estratégias de ingestão em modalidade Stream e fluxos transacionais.

Design de Soluções (As-Is e To-Be): Mapear o estado atual e projetar o roadmap futuro, documentando regras de negócio e pipelines.

Gestão de Engenharia e Qualidade: Garantir a aplicação de modelos de Fato e Dimensão com rotinas de validação na infraestrutura.

Gestão de Alta Performance: Atuar com foco em Metas e Resultados, realizando a gestão de prazos, recursos físicos e financeiros (FinOps).

Definição de arquitetura de governança e virtualização de dados.

Definição e implantação de ferramentas de aquisição, com construção completa de pipelines de ingestão de dados.

Atuar como referência técnica, mentorando o time e disseminando conhecimento sobre as plataformas e tecnologias adotadas.

Projetar e implementar soluções de dados ponta a ponta, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e segurança.

Definir modelos de dados otimizados para custo e eficiência.

Estabelecer modelo de orquestração e otimizar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) em ambientes batch e streaming.


PERFIL E REQUISITOS:

Formação Acadêmica: Sólida formação em Engenharia de Software, Computação ou Ciência da Computação ou cursos correlatos com especialização em Dados.

Idiomas: Habilidade avançada com a língua inglesa (leitura, escrita e conversação).

Comunicação Interpessoal: Habilidade para influenciar stakeholders executivos e orientar times técnicos.

Domínio de Ambientes Híbridos: Experiência comprovada na integração de ambientes On-premises com soluções Cloud.

Frameworks e Metodologias: Conhecimento sólido em TOGAF e experiência com modelos Hub-and-Spoke/Sandbox.

Especialista em Cloud (GCP): Domínio de BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer e AlloyDB.

Multi-Cloud e Bancos de Dados: Vivência com AWS, OCI e Bancos Oracle CDB/PDB, MongoDB e AlloyDB, CloudSQl, BigTable.


DIFERENCIAIS:

Certificações Cloud: Certificações oficiais Google Cloud (GCP Professional Data Engineer).

Tecnologias Emergentes: Experiência com Denodo e uso de IA para aceleração de desenvolvimento de atividades de engenharia de dados.

Desejável experiência na ferramenta Denodo.

Participação na estruturação de processos.

Buscamos um arquiteto que una o rigor acadêmico com a vivência prática de mercado. Este profissional será o maestro da integração tecnológica da Copel, garantindo que a inovação aconteça com segurança, transparência e alta disponibilidade técnica.

title: Network Specialist

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.

About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.

  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, , looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Pleno
description:
Sobre a Academia do Universitário (AU)

Na AU, não acreditamos em estágio como um período improvisado. Acreditamos em estágio como sistema . Construímos o Sistema Operacional de Estágio para o mercado corporativo, e nossa stack é o alicerce que permite transformar a entrada de jovens talentos em um processo previsível, tecnológico e de alto impacto.


O desafio

Você será o guardião do nosso \"motor\": o backend.

Seu foco principal estará na construção de APIs de alta performance, na integridade da lógica de domínio seguindo DDD e na modelagem eficiente de dados com Prisma , garantindo que o núcleo da AU seja robusto o suficiente para suportar nossa escala na AWS .

Para que você possa focar 100% nessa complexidade estrutural e na inteligência do negócio, o Claude Code será seu braço direito para \"matar\" as demandas de Frontend e componentes de interface sem que isso se torne um gargalo ou uma distração do seu core técnico.


Suas responsabilidades (na prática)

Engenharia de Backend & Domínio

  • Implementar e manter a lógica de negócio seguindo os princípios de DDD , garantindo desacoplamento, testabilidade e um código que sobreviva ao tempo.
  • Evoluir nosso schema de dados e realizar queries complexas e performáticas utilizando Prisma ORM .
  • Garantir a segurança, escalabilidade e integridade das APIs que alimentam todo o nosso ecossistema.


Fullstack \"Powered by AI\"

  • Atuar no Frontend (Nest/TS) de forma ágil: você desenha o contrato da API e utiliza o Claude Code para gerar a implementação visual e integração, mantendo a autonomia total da entrega de ponta a ponta.


Gestão de Conhecimento e Qualidade

  • Documentar processos, decisões técnicas e arquitetura no nosso \"Cérebro Digital\" via Obsidian , facilitando o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Realizar Code Reviews críticos, com olhar clínico para a manutenção dos padrões de arquitetura definidos.


O que esperamos de você

  • Domínio avançado de NestJS : você deve se sentir confortável com sua arquitetura modular, injeção de dependência, uso de Providers e padrões de organização de código.
  • Experiência sólida com Node.js + Typescript .
  • Experiência prática com Prisma e bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL).
  • Conhecimento aplicado em DDD (Entidades, Value Objects, Aggregates, Repositories).
  • Habilidade em utilizar LLMs (Claude Code ) para acelerar o desenvolvimento, especialmente em contextos onde você não é o especialista (como o Frontend).
  • Mentalidade de Documentação First : organização e clareza no Obsidian são essenciais para o nosso time.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com testes automatizados (Jest, Vitest).
  • Familiaridade com serviços da AWS sob a ótica de desenvolvimento (S3, Lambdas, etc).
  • Experiência em startups ou ambientes de crescimento rápido.


Como vamos medir sucesso (90 dias)

  • Implementação de módulos complexos utilizando a arquitetura do NestJS e padrões de DDD .
  • Redução do tempo de entrega de features ponta-a-ponta, utilizando IA para agilizar o Front.
  • Documentação técnica estruturada e acessível no Obsidian .
  • Contribuição ativa para a evolução do schema de dados via Prisma .


Informações relevantes

  • Tipo de contrato: PJ
  • Remuneração: R$ 6.000 + PLR
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido (Cubo Itaú – Vila Olímpia, SP)
  • Etapas do processo seletivo: triagem > teste técnico > entrevista CTO > entrevista CEO


Benefícios:  

  • iFood Benefícios
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Descontos em farmácias
  • Telemedicina (Clínico, Especialista, Nutrição e Psicologia)


O nosso movimento é #ACulpaNãoÉMaisDoEstagiário

Se você é um desenvolvedor que ama a estrutura do backend, mas quer ter o superpoder da IA para entregar o produto completo, seu lugar é na AU.

Experiência prévia em processos estruturados de gestão de vulnerabilidades.

Noções de classificação e priorização de vulnerabilidades com base em CVSS.

Experiência com geração de relatórios executivos e técnicos sobre vulnerabilidades, exposição e remediação.
